Subhead exact string, with exactly one period at the end: 홈 화면에서 오늘을 확인.

Do not render: 홈 화면에서 바로.
Do not render: 한 주를 한눈에 보세요..

Use the same premium Apple-native layout as the attached reference family: small StudyPlanner logo, bold top headline, short gray subhead, large real localized Home Screen widget proof, white rounded canvas, restrained edge semicircle accents, soft depth. No fake UI, no fake widgets, no fake app icons, no ratings, no prices, no awards, no school logos, no App Store chrome.

Before returning the image, self-check: the image is exactly 1242x2688; the headline is exactly “한 주를 한눈에 보세요.” with one period; the subhead is exactly “홈 화면에서 오늘을 확인.” with one period.
